definition: As appears or is stated to be true, though not necessarily so.
exampleSentence: The disputed charter was purportedly penned by the monarch himself, though paleographers demur.

definition: As appears or is stated to be true, though perhaps not in reality.
exampleSentence: The treaty was ostensibly framed to safeguard merchant shipping, whilst secretly securing naval hegemony.

definition: Based on or involving conjecture; speculative.
exampleSentence: Any attribution of intentional malice to the minister remains entirely conjectural at this juncture.
Under relentless cross-examination, the defendant's specious alibi unraveled completely.

definition: Unable to be attacked, questioned, or defeated.
exampleSentence: The mathematician constructed an unassailable formal proof of the centuries-old conjecture.
